title: Ladakh
tagline: High passes, blue lakes and ancient monasteries
description: Ladakh is the Himalaya at its most dramatic: a high-altitude desert of ochre mountains, snow-dusted passes and lakes of impossible blue. Whitewashed monasteries cling to the cliffs at Thiksey, Hemis and Lamayuru, prayer flags snap in the wind, and the pace of life follows the seasons.

From Leh, cross Khardung La into the Nubra Valley to ride Bactrian camels on the dunes of Hunder, visit the border village of Turtuk, and spend a night beside Pangong Lake as it changes colour with the light — a road trip every traveller should make once.

highlights.title: Pangong Lake
highlights.text: A 134 km-long lake at 4,350 m that shifts from turquoise to sapphire through the day — unforgettable at sunrise.

highlights.title: Khardung La & Nubra
highlights.text: Cross one of the world's highest motorable passes to sand dunes, Bactrian camels and the village of Turtuk.

highlights.title: Monasteries of the Indus
highlights.text: Hemis, Thiksey, Shey and Lamayuru — centuries-old gompas with murals, prayer halls and sweeping views.

highlights.title: Leh's old town
highlights.text: Leh Palace, Shanti Stupa at sunset and the lively main bazaar, plus Rancho's school from '3 Idiots'.
